description: Unit tests for the HPACK decoder tables in HTTP/2, including static and dynamic table content verification, table resizing, and insertion tests.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTablesPeer
classes.description: Provides access to the number of dynamic entries in HpackDecoderTables for testing.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStaticTableTest
classes.description: Test fixture for static table content verification.

classes.name: HpackDecoderTablesTest
classes.description: Test fixture for dynamic table operations, including insertion, trimming, and resizing.

methods.name: num_dynamic_entries
methods.description: Returns the number of dynamic entries in the given HpackDecoderTables.

methods.name: MakeSpecStaticEntries
methods.description: Creates a vector of static entries based on the static table entries included from an external file.

methods.name: ShuffleCollection
methods.description: Shuffles a collection using the provided Http2Random instance.

methods.name: VerifyStaticTableContents
methods.description: Verifies that the static table contains the expected entries.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a header pair by index in the static table.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a header entry based on name and value.

methods.name: FakeInsert
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the fake dynamic table for testing.

methods.name: FakeSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the fake dynamic table.

methods.name: FakeTrim
methods.description: Trims the fake dynamic table to the specified size limit.

methods.name: VerifyDynamicTableContents
methods.description: Verifies that the actual dynamic table matches the fake dynamic table.

methods.name: DynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Updates the dynamic table size limit and verifies table contents.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a header entry into the dynamic table and verifies table contents.
